strategies.retain: Use the original Machine failure target.
strategies.drop_conflicts: Remove all rows where Machine failure differs from any mode label.
strategies.total_from_modes: Define binary failure as any mode prediction being positive.

d_protocol: Frozen models for retain and total_from_modes; refit with the same selected hyperparameters for drop_conflicts.
c_protocol: Validation-best engineered RF; frozen for retain and refit with the same hyperparameters for the other strategies.
